DTR · TALK ABOUT A SCENE

Fifteen Kilos on a Bed

STS-HS11-L3-1400P-HSSCIENG1112-STP-IMR-01 • HS Science Engineering Design 11-12 • Qualitative and Quantitative Criteria and Constraints
Look at the picture. You will answer some questions about it. Press the play button to hear each question. Record your answer for each question. You can listen to your answer and record it again. Click SUBMIT RECORDINGS when you have answered all the questions.
JUST FOR FUN · OPTIONAL
In a pitch competition a team gets a few minutes to convince judges to fund one design and nothing else. Farida, Omid, and Zarina took every number on that board from their own first week in this city, when each of them arrived with one bag and did homework on a flattened cardboard box. Fifty five centimeters is the size the airline let them carry. Fifteen kilos is what a stack of borrowed schoolbooks weighs.
The judges add one more requirement. The desk has to feel steady when you lean on it. Is that something you can measure with a number, or something you can only describe in words? Say which, and say why.
Optional. You do not have to record this one.
1
What is Farida doing?
Look at the picture. Explain Farida's action and its purpose in academic English, then say what her choice of that spot tells you about what the team values.
2
What is Omid holding?
Look at the picture. Explain what Omid holds and why it is raised in academic English, then say what a judge is meant to conclude from it.
3
What is the teacher doing?
Look at the picture. Explain the teacher's action in academic English, then say what would happen to this pitch if his answer came out wrong.
4
What place is this? How do you know?
Look at the picture. Explain what place this is in academic English, then rank your two strongest pieces of evidence and defend that order.
5
Tell me about the board.
Look at the picture. Explain what the board contains in academic English, then explain how its two sides ask different things of the designers.
6
What is Zarina wearing?
Look at the picture. Explain Zarina's clothing in academic English, then say what it reveals about the work going on in this space.
Record an answer for each question, then submit.
Content alignment: NGSS HS-ETS1-1 — Analyze a major global challenge to specify qualitative and quantitative criteria and constraints for solutions. ELD (Speaking — official ELPAC “Talk About a Scene”): PI.A.1, PII.B.3, PII.B.4, PII.B.5.
